_why: Battle Master, Menacing Attack: a hit spends one die, adds it to the damage, and the hedge-mage (WIS 1) fails the Wisdom save: Frightened for 1 round (through their next turn, so until the end of the player's next turn), no repeat save. Morale is off so the frightened turn plays out: its attack has disadvantage, and the fear is gone after that turn.
